none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize the convex robust objective F(x)=sup_w E[w(ξ)loss(x,ξ)] over a closed convex domain. Feasible densities satisfy w≥0, E[w]=1, w∈L², and E[(w−1)²]/2≤ρ.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ChiSquareConstrainedDro.lean: IsFeasibleDensity, objective, spec.admissible convex-domain and sample-subgradient inequalities.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Population distributionally robust optimization with a χ²-divergence constraint of public radius ρ>0.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call uses a fresh IID sample ξ and returns a sample-loss subgradient at the projected query. It is not stipulated to be an unbiased subgradient of the robust objective.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same call returns loss(projection(y),ξ), jointly with its sample subgradient.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Each oracle reply also returns the exact metric projection of the query onto the hidden domain. Projection is bundled into the counted oracle call.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ChiSquareConstrainedDro.lean: sampleOracle.answer and spec.admissible projection variational inequality; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Sample subgradients satisfy ‖sub(x,ξ)‖≤G pointwise, hence have second moment at most G². Losses satisfy 0≤loss(x,ξ)≤B pointwise.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is a complete real Hilbert space with second-countable Borel topology. A robust minimizer x* exists with ‖x0−x*‖≤R; the domain need not be bounded. Public information comprises the spaces, ρ,G,B,R,ε,x0, with ρ,G,B,ε>0 and R≥0. The loss, subgradient map, sampling law, and domain are hidden instance data.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ChiSquareConstrainedDro.lean: Params, Instance, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, and spec.admissible minimizer condition.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable output lying in the domain for every outcome, with integrable robust objective gap F(output)−F(x*) and expectation at most ε.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee is in expectation over algorithm randomness and the IID oracle stream, under a fixed oracle-call budget.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ChiSquareConstrainedDro.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and executeWithTrace; supplied extracted result budget.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: χ²-constrained population DRO with bounded convex sample losses, IID sampling, and expected objective-gap accuracy is an established optimization formulation.
